author: Mead, 1959

note.en: A slim jawfish of muddy bottoms known here from a single 1969 collection at 15 m off the Río Hone, a small mouthbrooder that lives in burrows and that a visitor is very unlikely to notice.
note.es: Un pez mandíbula delgado de fondos fangosos, conocido aquí por una sola colecta de 1969 a 15 m frente al Río Hone; es un pequeño incubador bucal que vive en madrigueras y que un visitante casi nunca notaría.

evidence: OBIS: 1 record in the region, off the Río Hone at 15 m (1969)

sources.t: OBIS occurrence records (UCR and LACM fish collections, AGRRA surveys), Gandoca to Limón region
